module.purpose: This file renders booking availability, including selectable time slots, capacity status, confirmation actions, overlap warnings, out-of-office markers, and loading placeholders.
module.summary: The component layer presents bookable times using localized timezone formatting and booking-state data. It handles paid-event confirmation messaging, capacity-based availability indicators, duplicate or unavailable slot prevention, captcha and loading constraints, overlay-calendar conflict detection, tentative selections, and optional direct confirmation. It also renders out-of-office periods, empty availability states, and skeleton loading content.
module.businessContext: This supports appointment scheduling by showing customers when an event can be booked and whether capacity remains. Failure can hide valid availability, permit invalid selections, or prevent confirmations.
classes: TOnTimeSelect (~L28-33): Callback contract for selecting booking times with attendees, capacity, and identifiers.
TOnTentativeTimeSelect (~L35-45): Callback contract for tentative selections requiring structured time and attendee details.
AvailableTimesProps (~L47-54): Props defining slot collections, presentation options, selection callbacks, and unavailable times.
SlotItemProps (~L56-79): Props controlling individual slot rendering, booking state, confirmation, capacity, and validation.
IOOOSlotProps (~L304-311): Props describing out-of-office timing, reason, emoji, and presentation styling.
functions: SlotItem (~L81-261): Renders a selectable booking slot with capacity, validation, confirmation, and overlap feedback.
AvailableTimes (~L263-302): Displays available slots, empty states, and positioned out-of-office periods.
OOOSlot (~L313-329): Renders an out-of-office marker unless the current environment is platform mode.
AvailableTimesSkeleton (~L331-337): Displays randomized loading placeholders while available times are being fetched.
systemCapabilities: Support tentative and confirmed booking flows

Event data may be absent, and payment status depends on its optional price and payment metadata.

Callbacks are optional; selection actions occur only when the corresponding callback is supplied.
